description: Low-level escape hatch: apply an RFC 7386 JSON merge patch to the whole v3 site document returned by get_site.document (objects merge, null deletes a key, arrays REPLACE). Prefer the specific site ops. The result is validated against the theme before anything is saved. An outside image url in an image setting is copied into the business's media library and the setting stores our copy; if it can't be downloaded the call fails with image_fetch_failed and nothing changes.

patch.description: RFC 7386 JSON merge patch on the whole theme data document

name: update_site
title: Update site
